rumen_protected_fat_dairy.notes: Calcium salt of fatty acids. Typical inclusion 200-400g/head/day.

sodium_bicarbonate_dairy.notes: Rumen buffer. Typical use 200g/head/day in high-grain dairy TMR.

urea_ruminant.notes: NPN source — 281% CP equivalent. Max 1% of DM in cattle, 0.5% in small ruminants. Toxicity risk if overfed.

monensin_beef.notes: Ionophore feed additive. Improves feed efficiency 3-7%. Include at label rate only. Not for dairy.

corn_grain_sheep.notes: Copper max 15ppm in total sheep diet — monitor Cu from all sources

sheep_mineral_premix.notes: Low copper formulation — sheep are highly sensitive to copper toxicity. Max total dietary Cu: 15ppm DM.

pasture_sheep.notes: Highly variable. Values represent mid-season temperate mixed pasture.

browse_goat.notes: Typical browse estimate for mixed shrub species. Highly variable by species and season.

goat_mineral_premix.notes: Higher copper than sheep premix — goats tolerate up to 80ppm Cu total diet.

vitamin_ade_ruminant.notes: Vit A 500,000 IU/kg + Vit D3 100,000 IU/kg + Vit E 5,000 IU/kg. Typical inclusion 5-10g/head/day.

rumen_protected_methionine_sheep.notes: Provides ~55% bioavailable Met. Include at 0.03-0.08% DM

rumen_protected_lysine_sheep.notes: Provides ~50% bioavailable Lys. Include at 0.05-0.15% DM
